title: Need Multiple Timers At Once (And Need Them To Be Invisible)

posts.author: Uncommon-Aura
posts.body: I'm starting up dev on a casual gas station simulator game, and I'm immediately running into a roadblock with how I'm planning to handle all the random events that can happen. I need to be able to have multiple timers running at once, and have them all be invisible to the player. Initial searching did not turn up any plugins that allow multiple timers, so I'm asking here. It's fine if I need different plug-ins to achieve both parts of this. Thanks in advance!

posts.author: Slaughty
posts.body:
You could do a parallel process common event that increments variables by one every second or so. Then just do a conditional branch checking if variableX is Y then do stuff. For example:
Wait: 60
If GasStationEvent1 switch is off:
Add 1 to GasStationEvent1 variable
If GasStationEvent1 variable = 99 (or whatever)
-Turn GasStationEvent1 switch on, do stuff
Obviously you'd have to modify this for whatever you're trying to accomplish. Hope it is helpful. Good luck!

I've done exactly this before. You can set up all your various timers as a single common event that calls other common events to actually do something with the timer to cut down on parallel processes, such as automatically updating someone on screen, causing something to happen at 0, etc.
